Rules Of Procedure For The Conduct Of The Meetings Of The Assembly 1962
Rules Of
Procedure For The Conduct Of The Meetings Of The Assembly 1962
[Gazette of West
Pakistan, Extraordinary, 8th June 1962]
No. Gen. 5-4/62/3168.?Whereas, by Article 231 of the Constitution it is
provided that until Rules of its Procedure are made by the Provincial Assembly
of West Pakistan, the Procedure of the Assembly shall be regulated by Rules of
Procedure made by the Government of West Pakistan ;
And
whereas, the Governor of West Pakistan has made the requisite Rules of Procedure ;
And
whereas, under the Constitution, the Speaker or a Deputy Speaker elected by a
previous Assembly remains in office until its successor Assembly has elected
its own Speaker and Deputy Speakers ;
And
whereas, there being no Assembly under the Constitution previous to the
commencing day of the Constitution there will be no Speaker or Deputy Speaker
to preside over the Assembly until a Speaker has been elected by the Assembly ;
And
whereas it is necessary to make provision for the conduct of the meetings of
the Assembly until an elected Speaker takes the Chair ;
And
whereas it will take the Assembly some time before the Standing Committees and
other sub-organs of the Assembly are established by the Assembly and there is
need for making provision for the functions of the Assembly to be performed
during the period before these sub-organs are established ;
And
whereas, it will take the Governor of West Pakistan 'some time before his
Council of Ministers and Parliamentary Secretaries are appointed and there is
need to make provision in respect of the function that a Minister or a
Parliamentary Secretary has to perform in relation to proceedings in the
Assembly during the period before such a Minister or Parliamentary Secretary is
appointed ;
Now, therefore, the Governor of
West Pakistan is pleased to make the following special Rules of Procedure, to
provide for the aforesaid contingencies :
1. The duties and functions of
the Speaker under the Rules of Procedure of the Provincial Assembly of West
Pakistan made by the Governor of West Pakistan in pursuance of Article 231 of
the Constitution, shall, until a Speaker is duly elected by the Assembly, be
performed by Mr. Justice Masud Ahmad, Member,
Election Commission, Pakistan.
2. In the aforesaid Rules, those
Rules that relate to functions of a Standing Committee or any other Sub-organ
of the Assembly, and those Rules that relate to functions of a Minister/a
Parliamentary Secretary in relation to proceedings in the Assembly, shall remain inoperative and may be dispensed with
till such time as that Committee or Sub-organ is con?stituted by the Assembly,
or that a Minister or Parliamentary Secretary is appointed by the Governor of
West Pakistan.
3. The Programme
of the Meetings of the Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan up to the
introduction of the Budget shall be as given in Annexure.
